parts.instr: Read each question and answer Yes or No. Press ? if you did not understand. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer; ? scores 0.

parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: but life is made much easier
can believe what other people say.
in order to draw the fire
and also to carry the smoke away
into the air high above the factory
by the wind. It is often easier

parts.text: It is often easier to tell a lie than to tell the truth but life is made much easier and much more pleasant if we tell the truth and in return can believe what other people say. Factory chimneys are usually quite high in order to draw the fire and also to carry the smoke away into the air high above the factory to be blown away by the wind. It is often easier to tell a lie than to tell the truth.
